    print(("PASS  " if cond else "FAIL  ") + label + ("" if cond else "  -> " + detail))
    return cond

opening = D(rows[0]["balance"]) - D(rows[0]["amount"])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Post-audit final validation: 2025 Schedule C / SE for Dana Okafor.
Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP re-derivation of every form line, the SE chain, and every
quoted alternate, plus file-level reconciliation and stale-string scan."""

import csv, json
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP

D = Decimal
def cent(x): return x.quantize(D("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
def ok(label, cond, detail=""):
    print(("PASS  " if cond else "FAIL  ") + label + ("" if cond else "  -> " + detail))
    return bool(cond)

results = []
BANK = "/work/workspace/documents/bank_checking_2024-12_to_2026-01.csv"
CLS  = "/work/workspace/deliverable/classification.csv"
MD   = "/work/workspace/deliverable/schedule_c.md"
JSN  = "/work/workspace/deliverable/schedule_c.json"

# ---------- 1. Bank export: row count, running-balance chain ----------
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(BANK)))
results.append(ok("bank rows == 149", len(rows) == 149, str(len(rows))))
opening = D(rows[0]["balance"]) - D(rows[0]["amount"])
prev = opening; chain_ok = True
for r in rows:
    if D(r["balance"]) != prev + D(r["amount"]): chain_ok = False; break
    prev = D(r["balance"])
results.append(ok("balance chain exact on every row", chain_ok))
results.append(ok("implied opening 4,210.33", opening == D("4210.33"), str(opening)))
closing = D(rows[-1]["balance"])
results.append(ok("closing 32,955.15", closing == D("32955.15"), str(closing)))
results.append(ok("net movement +28,744.82", closing - opening == D("28744.82"), str(closing - opening)))

payhub = sum((D(r["amount"]) for r in rows if "PAYHUB" in r["description"]), D(0))
results.append(ok("PayHub payouts 40,150.85", payhub == D("40150.85"), str(payhub)))
tessaro = sum((D(r["amount"]) for r in rows if "TESSARO" in r["description"]), D(0))
results.append(ok("Tessaro total 12,400.00 (3,000 prior-yr + 9,400 2025)", tessaro == D("12400.00"), str(tessaro)))
feb = [r for r in rows if r["date"] == "2025-02-06" and "PAYHUB" in r["description"]]
results.append(ok("1099-K probe: box 5b Feb 1,866.68 x 0.971 = 1,812.55 = payout 2025-02-06",
    len(feb) == 1 and D(feb[0]["amount"]) == D("1812.55")))

# ---------- 2. classification.csv ----------
crows = list(csv.DictReader(open(CLS)))
results.append(ok("classification rows == 149", len(crows) == 149, str(len(crows))))
seq_ok = all(crows[i]["date"] == rows[i]["date"] and D(crows[i]["amount"]) == D(rows[i]["amount"]) for i in range(149))
results.append(ok("1:1 sequence (date,amount) with bank", seq_ok))
allowed = {"business_income","business_expense","personal","prior_year","tax_payment","transfer","other_schedule"}
extra = {c["class"] for c in crows} - allowed
results.append(ok("only allowed classes used", not extra, str(extra)))

cls_sum = {}
for c in crows: cls_sum[c["class"]] = cls_sum.get(c["class"], D(0)) + D(c["amount"])
for k, v in {"business_income": D("49550.85"), "business_expense": D("-10418.88"),
             "personal": D("-23265.83"), "prior_year": D("2915.88"),
             "tax_payment": D("-6500.00"), "other_schedule": D("16462.80"),
             "transfer": D("0.00")}.items():
    got = cls_sum.get(k, D(0))
    results.append(ok(f"class {k} == {v}", got == v, str(got)))
results.append(ok("class sums total == net movement 28,744.82",
    sum(cls_sum.values(), D(0)) == D("28744.82"), str(sum(cls_sum.values(), D(0)))))

be = D("-10418.88")
l28_from_csv = -be - D("1860") + D("1116") - D("95") + D("999.60") + D("1199.15")
results.append(ok("CSV bridge to line 28: 10,418.88 - 1,860 + 1,116 - 95 + 999.60 + 1,199.15 = 11,778.63",
    l28_from_csv == D("11778.63"), str(l28_from_csv)))

# ---------- 3. Schedule C re-derivation (ROUND_HALF_UP) ----------
L1 = D("41350.00") + D("9400.00")
results.append(ok("Line 1 = 41,350 + 9,400 = 50,750.00", L1 == D("50750.00")))
fee = D("41350.00") - D("40150.85")
results.append(ok("Line 10 = 1,199.15 == 41,350 x 2.9%", fee == D("1199.15") and D("41350.00")*D("0.029") == fee, str(fee)))

misc = 14+38+11+14+58+38+22+16+58+9
results.append(ok("itemized errand miles sum 278", misc == 278, str(misc)))
L9 = cent((D(misc) + 1150) * D("0.70"))
results.append(ok("Line 9 = (278 + 1,150) x 0.70 = 999.60", L9 == D("999.60"), str(L9)))
blocks = D(936) + D(1296)
results.append(ok("commuting blocks 936 + 1,296 = 2,232 (nondeductible)", blocks == D("2232")))
total_log = D(1200) + D(misc) + D(1150) + blocks
results.append(ok("log total 4,860 ties to client figure", total_log == D("4860")))
client_claim = cent(total_log * D("0.655"))
results.append(ok("client claim 4,860 x 0.655 = 3,183.30", client_claim == D("3183.30"), str(client_claim)))
results.append(ok("overstatement 3,183.30 - 999.60 = 2,183.70", client_claim - L9 == D("2183.70")))

L25base = D("85.00")*12 + D("70.00")*12
L25 = cent(L25base * D("0.60"))
results.append(ok("Line 25 = (1,020 + 840) x 60% = 1,116.00", L25base == D("1860.00") and L25 == D("1116.00")))
L27a = D("540.00") + D("719.88") + D("650.00") + D("2149.00")
results.append(ok("Line 27a = 4,058.88", L27a == D("4058.88"), str(L27a)))
L28 = L9 + fee + D("480.00") + D("2800.00") + D("1030.00") + D("95.00") + L25 + L27a
results.append(ok("Line 28 = 11,778.63", L28 == D("11778.63"), str(L28)))
L29 = L1 - L28
L31 = L29 - D("0.00")
results.append(ok("Lines 29/31 = 38,971.37", L29 == D("38971.37") and L31 == L29))

NE  = cent(L31 * D("0.9235"))
TAX = cent(NE * D("0.153"))
HALF= cent(TAX / 2)
results.append(ok("SE NE = 35,990.06", NE == D("35990.06"), str(NE)))
results.append(ok("SE tax = 5,506.48", TAX == D("5506.48"), str(TAX)))
results.append(ok("1/2 SE tax = 2,753.24", HALF == D("2753.24"), str(HALF)))
wb = D("24800.00") + NE
results.append(ok("SS wage base 60,790.06 <= 176,100 (no cap interaction)", wb == D("60790.06") and wb <= D("176100")))

# ---------- 4. Alternates quoted in the MD ----------
t24b = cent(D("64.00") * D("0.50")); t28 = L28 - D("63.00"); t31 = L1 - t28
tNE = cent(t31 * D("0.9235")); tTAX = cent(tNE * D("0.153")); tHALF = cent(tTAX / 2)
results.append(ok("alt Tartine: 24b 32.00", t24b == D("32.00")))
results.append(ok("alt Tartine: 28 = 11,778.63 - 63.00 = 11,715.63", t28 == D("11715.63"), str(t28)))
results.append(ok("alt Tartine: 31 = 39,034.37 (profit UP 63.00)", t31 == D("39034.37") and t31 == L31 + D("63.00")))
results.append(ok("alt Tartine: NE 36,048.24; tax 5,515.38; 1/2 2,757.69",
    (tNE, tTAX, tHALF) == (D("36048.24"), D("5515.38"), D("2757.69")), f"{tNE}/{tTAX}/{tHALF}"))

b28 = L28 - L25; b31 = L1 - b28
bNE = cent(b31 * D("0.9235")); bTAX = cent(bNE * D("0.153")); bH = cent(bTAX/2)
results.append(ok("Q1 base row (line 25 at $0): 10,662.63 / 40,087.37 / 37,020.69 / 5,664.17 / 2,832.09",
    (b28, b31, bNE, bTAX, bH) == (D("10662.63"), D("40087.37"), D("37020.69"), D("5664.17"), D("2832.09")),
    f"{b28}/{b31}/{bNE}/{bTAX}/{bH}"))

for tag, extra_inc, eprofit, eNE, eTAX, eH in [
    ("1099-K only (Beacon outside)",  D("18500.00"), D("58587.37"), D("54105.44"), D("8278.13"),  D("4139.07")),
    ("Orchard outside",               D("12200.00"), D("52287.37"), D("48287.39"), D("7387.97"),  D("3693.99")),
    ("both outside",                  D("30700.00"), D("70787.37"), D("65372.14"), D("10001.94"), D("5000.97")),
]:
    p31 = (L1 + extra_inc) - b28
    pNE = cent(p31 * D("0.9235")); pTAX = cent(pNE * D("0.153")); pH = cent(pTAX/2)
    results.append(ok(f"Q1 row '{tag}': profit {eprofit} / NE {eNE} / tax {eTAX} / half {eH}",
        (p31, pNE, pTAX, pH) == (eprofit, eNE, eTAX, eH), f"{p31}/{pNE}/{pTAX}/{pH}"))

q9 = cent(D(misc) * D("0.70")); q28 = L28 - L9 + q9; q31 = L1 - q28
qNE = cent(q31 * D("0.9235")); qTAX = cent(qNE * D("0.153"))
results.append(ok("Q3 disallow alt: 9 = 194.60; 28 = 10,973.63; 31 = 39,776.37; NE = 36,733.48; tax = 5,620.22",
    (q9, q28, q31, qNE, qTAX) == (D("194.60"), D("10973.63"), D("39776.37"), D("36733.48"), D("5620.22")),
    f"{q9}/{q28}/{q31}/{qNE}/{qTAX}"))

# ---------- 5. W-2 payroll checks ----------
w2_net = D("24800.00") - D("2310.00") - D("1537.60") - D("359.60")
results.append(ok("W-2: SS 1,537.60 (6.2%); Medicare 359.60 (1.45%); implied net 20,592.80",
    D("24800")*D("0.062") == D("1537.60") and D("24800")*D("0.0145") == D("359.60") and w2_net == D("20592.80")))
results.append(ok("bank payroll credits 19,502.80; unexplained gap 1,090.00",
    D("19502.80") + D("1090.00") == w2_net))

# ---------- 6. schedule_c.json agreement ----------
j = json.load(open(JSN))
jlines = {k: D(str(v)) for k, v in j["lines"].items()}
recomputed = {"1": L1, "2": D("0.00"), "3": L1, "4": D("0.00"), "5": L1, "6": D("0.00"), "7": L1,
              "9": L9, "10": fee, "13": D("0.00"), "15": D("480.00"), "18": D("0.00"), "20b": D("2800.00"),
              "24a": D("1030.00"), "24b": D("95.00"), "25": L25, "27a": L27a, "28": L28,
              "29": L29, "30": D("0.00"), "31": L31}
results.append(ok("JSON lines dict == recomputation (21 keys)", jlines == {k: D(str(v)) for k, v in recomputed.items()},
    str(jlines)))
se = j["schedule_se"]
results.append(ok("JSON SE = 35,990.06 / 5,506.48 / 2,753.24",
    (D(str(se["net_earnings"])), D(str(se["se_tax"])), D(str(se["deductible_half"]))) == (NE, TAX, HALF)))
results.append(ok("JSON not_on_schedule_c has 12 items", len(j["not_on_schedule_c"]) == 12))
expected_nos = {D("24800"), D("2310"), D("6500"), D("3040"), D("3000"), D("19800"),
                D("2102.95"), D("185.88"), D("588"), D("389"), D("200"), D("84.12")}
got_nos = {D(str(x["amount"])) for x in j["not_on_schedule_c"]}
results.append(ok("not_on_schedule_c amount set matches", got_nos == expected_nos, str(got_nos ^ expected_nos)))

# ---------- 7. schedule_c.md figure presence ----------
md = open(MD).read()
must = ["$50,750.00","$999.60","$1,199.15","$480.00","$2,800.00","$1,030.00","$95.00","$1,116.00",
        "$4,058.88","$11,778.63","$38,971.37","$35,990.06","$5,506.48","$2,753.24",
        "$2,183.70","$3,183.30",
        "$11,715.63","$39,034.37","$36,048.24","$5,515.38","$2,757.69",
        "$194.60","$10,973.63","$39,776.37","$5,620.22",
        "$10,662.63","$40,087.37","$37,020.69","$5,664.17","$2,832.09",
        "the cost of basic local telephone service for the first line into your home is not deductible"]
for m in must:
    results.append(ok(f"MD contains '{m}'", m in md))

# ---------- 8. Stale-string scan ----------
stale = ["****ASSUMPTION","Confirmation requested in Q1","qualifying qualifying","business casual",
         "include-taxed-once","box 5a–l","11,841.63","38,908.37","5,497.58","(confirm, Q6)",
         "business purpose to confirm","$0 deducted pending","subject to open item",
         "at $0 a pre-confirmation","likely benefit/payroll detail","(3×/week, 9 mi round trip)"]
blobs = {"schedule_c.md": md, "classification.csv": open(CLS).read(), "schedule_c.json": open(JSN).read()}
for name, blob in blobs.items():
    for s in stale:
        results.append(ok(f"no stale string '{s}' in {name}", s not in blob))

# ---------- 9. Mileage-log inconsistency diagnostics ----------
w1 = 123/7; w2 = 122/7   # May 1-Aug 31 / Sep 1-Dec 31, weeks
print(f"  [info] 936 mi May-Aug:  {936/9/w1:.1f} trips/wk @ 9 mi r/t vs {936/18/w1:.1f} @ 18 mi r/t  (log label 3x/wk)")
print(f"  [info] 1,296 mi Sep-Dec: {1296/9/w2:.1f} trips/wk @ 9 mi r/t vs {1296/18/w2:.1f} @ 18 mi r/t (log label 3x/wk)")

# ---------- verdict ----------
runs = sum(results); total = len(results)
print(f"\nCHECKS: {runs}/{total} passed")
print("RESULT: ALL CHECKS PASS" if runs == total else "RESULT: FAILURES PRESENT (see FAIL lines above)")
